summary: One or more exact text sequences that stop Claude when it generates a match. The matching sequence ends the response and is reported through the provider stop reason rather than being treated as ordinary answer text.
combines: Applies alongside `max_tokens`; whichever termination condition is reached first ends the response.
A stop sequence can cut off JSON, prose, or a tool-use turn before it is complete, so it is unsafe as a general user control in Lixpi's structured tool workflow.
It does not replace tool choice or structured-output validation. Lixpi leaves provider and orchestration termination rules in control.
